notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 8 of 32 text layers are full attention (text_config layer_types: 8 full_attention, 24 linear_attention, full_attention_interval 4). 8 x 4 KV heads x 256 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 32,768 B/token (32.0 KiB). The Qwen3.5 text backbone sets the geometry, head_dim 256 explicit; the 24 linear-attention layers keep a fixed-size state. The audio encoder is bidirectional - one pass over the mel frames, no per-token cache. context_tokens is text_config.max_position_embeddings 262144, not an audio-frame window. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card publishes live-commerce benchmark table; all six claimed metrics match the 4B column. CARD-TABLE COMPLETION 2026-11-01: the record held six summary rows; the card's task table prints eighteen atomic rows and the other twelve were unrecorded (Audio Description Hal. 20.97, Visual Grounding Live AP 82.85 / Prod AP 91.45, Text Understanding Loc F1 86.99 / Rec NED 4.72 / Cls Acc 79.06, Dense Caption Acc 69.23 / Hal 9.57, Shot Understanding Layout 78.40 / Shot Size 51.20 / Camera 80.90 / Content 69.80). Eleven of twelve are sub-metrics the recorded summary rows average over; three are hallucination rates, which the card reports separately and which no summary row captures. Hal./NED/mAP rows are lower-is-better and say so in the name.
